checkedAlternates.risk: Informed consent directly implements the Belmont principle of Respect for Persons.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Informed consent is an operational clinical/IRB safeguard procedure (group-2), whereas Respect for Persons, Beneficence, and Justice are the three foundational Belmont Report principles (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: The Precautionary Principle aims to prevent harm like Beneficence.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Precautionary Principle is a regulatory risk-governance rule under scientific uncertainty (group-1), not one of the three Belmont Report principles (group-3).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
